aggregation: COMET-22 of a cell is the mean over its scored items; chrF++ of a cell is corpus chrF++ from pooled sufficient statistics. A cell is one text type in one direction: 200 sentences or 20 passages. The overall score is, in each direction, the mean of the sentence and passage cells (50:50), then the mean over directions with equal weight. Paired differences use, cell by cell, the items both systems scored. Intervals are the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of 2,000 paired document draws and are not adjusted for multiple comparisons or for leaders chosen on the same data.

bootstrap.description: Paired document bootstrap: each source document gets one multiplicity per draw in every cell it appears in; 95% intervals are the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles.
